column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
# A base of - means no red run was possible. Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
a checker short of controls resolves short, naming what it lacks
a checker whose only row is malformed is short, not absent
a checker with a row for every control resolves complete
a dash names nothing
a row needing three capabilities resolves each of them
a row refused for its needs is never evaluated
a seven-column row names nothing that would discharge it
an engine shipped without the qualification library resolves nothing, rather than absent
an id no checker carries resolves absent
and engine_deployed needs deploy, absent the same way
and is refused at the merge boundary
and its summary line carries the same count
and prints the count under it
and reads as naming nothing
and says complete is declared, not run
and shows each row's need with its resolution
and the row that names nothing, saying so
and the summary line counts them
felix's lifecycle_wired needs lifecycle, which no checker declares
needs [9lives] refuses the row with the reason
needs [Deploy] refuses the row with the reason
needs [a,,b] refuses the row with the reason
needs [ok,] refuses the row with the reason
needs [x, y] refuses the row with the reason
the count is one per obligation, by its weakest need
the schema check accepts the eighth column as needs
the template documents the needs column
